title: Prepare external-agent task merge handoff and admit resolved bytes
outcome: Prepare external-agent task merge handoff and admit resolved bytes
acceptance: An explicit retained exchange operation supplies complete base/local/incoming documents, changed IDs and relevant dependency closure without a model call or semantic last-writer-wins; mechanically carried disjoint changes and unresolved same-task/lifecycle/graph conflicts remain visible and preserve every captured side.

Pre-commit admission binds an uncommitted resolved candidate to exact operation and both sides, validates complete IDs/schema/reference closure/cycles/no unexplained deletions and note/activity invariants, preserves original note bytes/IDs and only known captured or imported additions, and explicitly refuses edited originals, arbitrary ID-bearing drafts and unsupported replacement-note creation.

Owned tests prove same-operation exact retry, preservation on branch/task-basis drift and invalid/conflicted resolution, distinct and overlapping task edits, terminal/open conflicts, graph cycles and note identity/collision boundaries; admission never claims fetched means merged, committed or imported.

No commit/push, divergent SQLite application or canonical imported-commit receipt, new note-origin durable representation, TermAl relay or authority expansion is introduced; any contrary durable requirement goes to Greg before coding.
